title: HINGE & LOCK PILLAR TO DOOR SILL REINFORCEMENT
summary: Steel birdcage at the door opening: the door sill (rocker) reinforcement [1] is spot-welded to the hinge pillar (A-pillar) at the front and to the lock pillar (B-pillar) reinforcement [2] at the rear, with supports [3], [4] and [5] and the inner hinge pillar reinforcement [6] welded in. Convertible (19467) uses a different lock pillar reinforcement. A plug [7] closes a hole in the top of the sill reinforcement. All joints are spot welds (one gas/arc weld), counts given per side.

parts.name: REINF ASM-DOOR SILL
parts.name_expanded: Reinforcement assembly – door sill (rocker reinforcement), LH/RH

parts.name: REINF ASM-LOCK PILLAR
parts.name_expanded: Reinforcement assembly – lock pillar (B-pillar), LH/RH, convertible

fastening.note: Spot welds, 1.00 pitch, at the front end of the sill reinforcement.
Spot welds at the rear (lock pillar) end of the sill: 2A 1.00 pitch, 2B 1.12 pitch, 2C 1.00 pitch.
Spot welds: 3A 1.38 pitch along the bottom flange, 3B 1.25 pitch; support [3] is the angled brace at the front of the sill.
Spot welds, 1.00 pitch (View A, support [4] at the hinge pillar foot).
Spot welds; support [5] is the gusset at the foot of the lock pillar.
Plug [7] pushed into the hole in the top face of the sill reinforcement, just behind the hinge pillar.
